Made by Studio3D.

StudioIA comes from Studio3D, an architectural visualization studio. Turning architecture projects into images people understand is the studio's everyday work, and StudioIA puts that into a tool architects and interior designers use on their own models.

Studio3D

An architectural visualization studio. Its symbol says what it does: the black piece is a project still in technical language; the colored pieces are that same project translated into images anyone can read.

Follow Studio3D on Instagram

The product

From a screenshot of your model to a photograph: mask the regions, assign real products from your library, set the scene, and render.

What we hold to

  • Product-accurate, not just photoreal

    The product you specify is the product that appears, not a lookalike.

  • Your geometry, preserved

    Every render is checked against your screenshot; drift is measured and reported, never hidden.

  • Costs you can see

    One model call per render, with its latency and estimated cost shown up front.

  • Private by design

    Your projects are yours: tied to your account and never shown to anyone else.
